conditions: Full-source lengths are compared under the existing principal-result contracts, not all-assertions equivalence.
L079 semilinear census/Conjecture11 and L021 final PGL question remain excluded from mathematical recovery; their printed source text is still counted.
All-prime constructions are proved in A3. Validation contains only diagnostic samples and false-weakening controls; every literal correction witness remains required.
Some program-cost change comes from separating diagnostics; report the validation-inclusive sensitivity alongside primary known costs.
Source and replacement use the same declared external classical library; unknown underlying proof costs are not zero.
No historical novelty, new solved question, additional source credit, minimum-description-length or repeated sawtooth claim.

This edition improves prose and motivation without deleting proof material or programs. The earlier common-proof draft remains recorded at public commit 6d203fd; its measured factors are not silently rebound to this edition.
cost_allocation: Every full umbrella is paid once within its topic, regardless of overlap with another topic. New_Code is a single complete common artifact and is paid once at acquisition. Its A3-specific witnesses are not free: they remain in the full cost. Old extra code is paid with A3 as in the frozen old boundary. This packaging difference affects intermediate cumulative points and is disclosed; total costs do not depend on stage assignment.
interpretation: The source/new written factor compares full manuscript lengths for accepted main results. Known program coordinates include complete current required artifacts, with a separate complete-validation sensitivity. They are not exact all-artifact or unconditional proof costs. Cumulative stages use declared whole-file charging, not inferred historical discovery or repeated sawtooth evidence.
